Results.ReviewText:
As a longtime Weber owner — I currently have the Genesis® II S-335 (LP), the Genesis S-330 LP SS, and the Original Kettle Charcoal Grill 22" — I was disappointed with my new 22" Salute to Service Kettle.

Compared to my Original Kettle, the charcoal bowl on this unit radiates noticeably more heat, which is a concern I hadn't experienced with previous Weber kettles. In addition, the lid doesn't seat properly on the bowl, it needs to be adjusted or repositioned to fit correctly.

This is the first time I haven't been fully satisfied with a Weber product, and I wanted to flag these issues directly since I've been a loyal customer across multiple grill lines.
Results.Title: Heat & Lid Fit Issues on the Salute Service Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Bought this Kettle on sale at my local HD. Man has this Kettle been amazing. Had a slight defect in the lid and weber took care of me. They 100% stand by their product, and I 100% am a Lifetime buyer of Weber!
Results.Title: Amazing Purchase, no Regrets.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this to use becuase our natural gas grill was diconnected after 30+ years and I did not want to risk the old line leaking, I had it removed. I wanted to go back to charcoal and this grill worked good, it would be better with an adjustable rack, but it worked fine.
Results.Title: Charcoal Kettle Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for sharing your experience. We are sorry to her that the finish in this area caused concern, especially before you had the opportunity to use your grill. 

The area shown in your photo is a crease/joint in the handle where the porcelain coating cannot fully adhere, so some exposed metal in this location is normal. This does not necessarily indicate a defect or mean that the bowl will rust through. 

That said, we certainly understand why seeing rust on a brand new grill would be concerning. We stand behind the quality and durability of our products, and your grill is backed  by our warranty should you ever experience an issue that falls outside of normal wear or construction. We appreciate you choosing Weber and hope you are able to enjoy many great cooks with your kettle.

Results.ReviewText: Picked this up for the Home Depot, and when I got home unboxed it and put it together, upon doing that I noticed a part on the lid and the bowl where the finish was missing and started to rust before I got the first use on it. I reached out to Weber support and got told it was fine run it, I really wish they would stand behind their newer products more as this one will probably rust out before the warranty has expired
Results.Title: High hopes, moderate letdown

I used said grill and I am quite pleased.  I was especially pleased with the final price I paid for my  grill.  It was very easy to register the grill with Weber.

Results.ReviewText: As an Army veteran, I appreciate your decision to honor the 250th service anniversary. At present I'm celebrating the grill as a display piece; I haven't cooked with it yet. I'm still using my 36 year-old kettle instead.
Results.Title: Design and Utility

Results.ReviewText: I already have a Weber Performer and a 26" kettle but when I saw the Salute To Service Kettle I had to have it. As a veteran I appreciate the nod to those of us that have served. I immediately upgraded this kettle by adding an ash catcher and a Spider Grills Kettle Cart along with some all terrain casters. It now looks even more awesome! As far as performance it's a Weber Kettle. I've been cooking on Weber Kettel's since the early 80's and they are fantastic. I can grill hot and fast or I can BBQ low and slow. For the price no outdoor cooker beats a Weber. And with minimal care they last for years. Weber Forever!
Results.Title: Hey it's a Weber Kettle.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for beginner to expert for a good price. This was an impulse buy and worth every penny.  It’s versatile and easy to use.  Great item for collectors too.
Results.Title: My first kettle

Results.ReviewText: This was my first use of my new Weber for July 4th. I was excited to BBQ for my youngest daughter return from her vacation. I cooked wings, ribs, hot links and thighs and the grill handled each protein extremely well. For dessert we grilled fresh peaches and they were delicious.
Results.Title: My first cook on my Weber

Results.ReviewText: As an Army veteran, the 22" Salute to Service Kettle means more to me than just another grill. The Army Green finish is a beautiful tribute to those who have served, and it immediately caught my attention. Beyond its unique appearance, it delivers the exceptional performance Weber is known for: heating and maintaining temperatures evenly and producing outstanding results every time I grill. It's a high-quality product that I'm proud to own and would highly recommend to anyone, especially my fellow veterans.
Results.Title: Outstanding Grill That Proudly Honors Our Military

Results.ReviewText: There's just no doubt about it.  The kettle is great for ribs and pulled pork. For the price it's hard to beat. Obviously you can also grill whatever meats you want on it as well.

1502395.Description: Show support for our nation’s service members with the 22” Salute to Service Kettle.
